articleTitle: Active inverter device with double closed loop control method for arc suppression in distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the distribution network, grounding faults occur frequently because of varied operating environment. With the continuous expansion of the distribution network, the control method of single-phase grounding fault arc suppression based on active inverter is not able to realize the fast and high precise restrain of the fault point current due to the poor dynamic stability of the controller and the uncertainty of the measurement in power distribution network. In this paper, injecting a current into the power system by controlling the active inverter can suppress the current of fault point to zero. And the double closed loop control method of active inverter device was designed, it can suppress faults current quickly and precisely without measuring the system parameters to-ground. Simulation and prototype testing results validated the effectiveness and feasibility of proposed method.

articleTitle: Fast disposal method for reducing electricity risk of single-phase ground fault in distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to realize the active arc suppression of the single-phase ground fault of the non-effective grounding system and reduce electricity risk, a fast disposal method for reducing the risk of electric shock of single-phase ground fault was proposed. When a single-phase ground fault occurred, the fault point was first located by the traveling wave positioning technology, and the voltage drop between the fault point and the power bus was calculated. The fault phase voltage was suppressed to zero through injecting current to control zero sequence voltage, which achieved full compensation of fault current and realized the purpose of arc suppression. The simulation results showed that the method was not affected by fault resistance, can quickly suppress the fault phase voltage, realize the full compensation of the ground fault point current of the distribution system, and effectively improve the safety level of the personal and equipment.

articleTitle: A novel control scheme for enhancing low voltage ride through capability of solar generation
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes an advanced coordinated control scheme for low voltage ride through (LVRT) of the smart solar inverter. In MATLAB Simulink, a two-stage three-phase grid-connected converter with a practical PV model is developed in several scenarios, including the zero voltage ride through (ZVRT), which is regarded as the most extreme case. The simulation result indicates the faster transient response and the better power quality, compared with previous strategies. Active power fluctuation is reduced and reactive power is produced with a specific gradient based on the depth of voltage dip to satisfy the grid code. A more precise solar energy reference is realized by the proposed strategy with novel controlling loops. It is worthy to mention that more power is captured and stored without any additional devices, due to the adaptive DC-Link voltage and the change of operating restrictions.

articleTitle: Simulation of the integrated energy system for isolated island
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Many islands locate along the coast of China, most of them are far away from mainland. Fortunately, the renewable energy resources are abundant around the islands. If the renewable energy can be fully utilized, the sustainable energy supply for the islands can be guaranteed. Hence, this paper provides a solution of the energy supply system for islands. To achieve this objective, this paper established an integrated energy system for isolated island, which consists of wind power generator, photovoltaic power generator, diesel power generator, desalination load, conventional load, power-to-gas and fuel cells. The renewable energy is used as the main power supply source, and the diesel generator is as a secondary emergency supply. For the sake of the stable and consistent operation of the system, a relevant energy control strategy has been designed in this paper, which ensures the system can satisfy the supply of electricity and freshwater.

articleTitle: Bidirectional modular Dual Active Bridge (DAB) converter using multi-limb-core transformer with symmetrical LC series resonant tank based on cascaded converters in solid state transformer (SST)
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a practical model for the DC-DC stage of solid state transformer (SST) focusing on analysis and modeling for modular Dual Active Bridge (DAB). The proposed converter topology is based on cascaded H-bridge to handle the high voltage conditions. The multi-limb core (MLC) medium/high-frequency transformer has been introduced to realize galvanic isolation. Synchronized half-duty-cycle switching method is applied to every H-bridge and relative DC voltage value is controlled to manipulate the power flow. LC symmetrical resonant network has been used to improve the converter performance. Simulation and experimental results are also presented for verification.

articleTitle: Modeling and analysis of the AC/DC hybrid micro-grid with bidirectional power flow controller
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increase of DC loads, the traditional AC micro-grids can not meet the demand of system load diversity and economy. In addition, the random, time-varying and nonlinear characteristics of the distributed generation (DG) make the DG modeling and algorithm realization relatively difficult, and the coordination and cooperation between DG and energy storage(ES) complex. This paper built a hybrid AC/DC micro-grid contains the DC distribution grid. The corresponding components of the physical model and control strategy were proposed. In the experiment, this paper focuses on the research of micro components under different working conditions. The results show that the proposed hybrid AC/DC micro-grid structure is reasonable, and the control strategy and performance of the components is good. The whole system has fast response speed, and can well satisfy the requirement of system security and stability.

articleTitle: Short-and mid-term load forecasting using machine learning models
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the ever-increasing load demand for diversified users, load forecasting emerges as an integral part in the energy management system (EMS). Improving the load prediction accuracy is of great significance to the construction and development of smart grid. This paper focuses on forecasting short and medium terms of electrical load using three machine learning models as follows: Linear Regression (LR), Support Vector Regression (SVR), Gradient Boosting Regression Trees (GBRT). The input features contain the correlation between the weather information and the electrical load data. The proposed models are tested with the data acquired from New York Independent System Operator (NYISO) data set. The simulation results show that although all models achieve satisfactory performance on prediction accuracy. Gradient Boosting Regression Trees model yields the most promising results on both short-and mid-term load forecasting with higher accuracy. A hybrid method of AdaBoost ensemble algorithm based on GBRT is proposed in this paper, which shows an improvement in load forecasting accuracy compared with the above three methods.

articleTitle: Eigenvalue analysis of subsynchronous oscillation in grid-connected PV power stations
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Along with the development of modern society, the fossil fuel increasingly exhausted, and living environment and energy problem have become the top challenges in our society. It is of great significance to research and make full use of renewable energy. Fast development of photovoltaic (PV) technology in recent years strongly indicates that in medium to long term, PV power stations may become more commercially attractive that there will be large-scale implementation in many countries in the world. With the increasing capacity and penetration rate of photovoltaic (PV) power stations, subsynchronous oscillation caused by grid-connected PV power stations begin to receive the attention of researchers. Subsynchronous oscillation will have a great influence on the security and stability of power system's operation. On the basis of overall considering detailed models of important components in grid-connected PV power stations, a whole system small signal model is established. Eigenvalue and participation factor analysis are used to study subsynchronous oscillation characteristics. The eigenvalues show that a subsynchronous oscillation mode may appear in the power system with PV power stations. The participation factor analysis shows that state 1 and state 6 (voltage outer-loop controller's states) are strongly correlated in subsynchronous oscillation mode. The effects of parameters in current inter-loop controller and voltage outer-loop controller of PV inverter on synchronous oscillation have been fully studied. It is found that the subsynchronous oscillation mode is sensitive to the parameters of voltage outer-loop controller.

articleTitle: Empirical study of the relationship between global energy consumption and economic growth
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The construction of the global energy internet is a historical transformation from the traditional concept of energy development to a up-to-date one, which will establish a new pattern of world energy development. There is a close relationship between and energy consumption and economic growth. This paper makes the empirical study of the relationship between energy consumption and economic growth in a global perspective. Based on adequate historical data, this paper studies the long-term co-integration and causality relationships between global energy consumption and economic growth by co-integration test, error correction model and Granger causality test. Worldwide energy consumption, electricity consumption and economic growth are then organized into one unified framework through vector auto-regression (VAR) model. The dynamic relationships and interactions are deduced by impulse response function and variance decomposition method. The result shows that constructing global energy internet to meet global electricity demand with clean and green alternatives are effective measures to ensure the rapid and sustainable development of the economy.

articleTitle: Stability and control of a grid integrated DFIM based variable speed pumped storage system
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents stability and control of a grid integrated doubly-fed induction machine (DFIM) based variable speed pumped storage (VSPS) system. The paper aims to verify whether the VSPS unit can support the grid frequency stability. Models of the converters with control units and the mechanical and electrical machines for the VSPS are developed based on phasor representation technique. Based on the dq-frame control theory, the direct power control strategy is designed. Steady-state and transient stability responses of the proposed system are analyzed in MATLAB/Simulink platform. Frequency stability responses are particularly evaluated by comparing between a grid with VSPS and without it. Frequency droop control is also proposed and validated. The results show that the VSPS improves the steady state operations and dynamic stability of the power system. The droop controller ensures that the frequency dynamic stability is highly improved. Hence, the VSPS system is effective in supporting the frequency stability, and adopting droop control in the power grid.

articleTitle: Research on large scale electric vehicles participating in the economic dispatch of wind and thermal power system
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The large-scale popularization of electric vehicles has brought great influence to the safe and stable operation of power system, and large scale wind power integration also bring serious volatility problem. In this paper, the dynamic economic dispatch model of power system with the minimum target of power generation cost, emission cost and wind power cost is studied, use the NSGA-II algorithm to solve the multi-objective function problem, and obtain the optimal solution set of the Pareto front. Then, transform the multi-objective function to a single objective function by using the linear weighted method, and solve the single objective function by the particle swarm optimization algorithm. Last, analyze the influencing factors of the economic dispatch of power system. The results show that the large scale electric vehicles participating in economic dispatch is conducive to wind power consumption.

articleTitle: Parameter identification of synchronous condenser based on sensitivity analysis of parameters
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The accuracy of the parameters of the synchronous condenser will impact on the stability analysis of the UHV DC system. A step-by-step identification strategy for estimating the parameters of the synchronous condenser is proposed in this paper. This strategy is based on the analysis of the trajectory sensitivity of the parameters of the sixth-order model of synchronous condenser parameters in different disturbances. By the step identification strategy, the search space for identification is reduced in each step and more accuracy identification results are obtained. The simulation results show that the proposed identification strategy can solve the problem of multi-value and the parameter instability, which is superior to the traditional one-time identification method of all parameters.

articleTitle: Research on VSC-HVDC double closed loop controller based on variable universe fuzzy PID control
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of flexible DC transmission technology, its application scope is more widespread. However, the small loop steady state model with double closed loop control, in the case of large system disturbance, is below the average control because of the constant parameter. In this paper, fuzzy PID control with the variable domain is introduced, and the initial value of the controller is obtained by using empirical formula. Considering that the initial domain does not necessarily meet the control requirements of all input signals, it introduces the scaling factor to adjust the domain of variables, improving the dynamic performance and control accuracy of the system. Finally, combined with double closed loop control, the simulation proves that the fuzzy PID control with the variable universe has better control effect and a wider range of VSC-HVDC application.

articleTitle: Virtual inertia control and voltage support in MMC-based DC systems
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Flexible DC transmission technology is developing rapidly, which is a better way to integrate distributed energy and long-distance power transmission. However the double loop control mode or vector control scheme provides almost no inertia to the AC system that decreases the stability of the grid during faults or other disturbances. In order to provide an improved control scheme, the key is to change the voltage source converter from taking the conventional control strategy to a frequency sensitive way. In this paper, the comparison between traditional synchronous machine and the present voltage source converter is presented. The role of MMC during transient period including virtual inertia control principle is discussed. The factors that may affects the deviation of frequency are explored. Finally, the performance of these strategies are evaluated for transients based on a MMC-HVDC system by PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: A software defined energy storage: Architecture, topology, and reliability
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the growth of renewable energy connecting to the grid, there is a demand for distributed and emerging energy storage technologies to be developed. Moreover, the fast demand of Cloud, Big Data, and Intelligent City industries demand that highly energy efficient Internet Data Center (IDC) to be flexible and have on-demand deployment for a sustainable profit business case. In the effort to make the energy storage management system independent of multiple battery technologies adopted, a new Software Defined Energy (SDE) storage technology is developed and applies the IDC operation. The SDE coupled with the IT equipment not only enables a new generation of highly reliable power system in IDC, but also provides the highly efficient IT power consumption solution. In this paper, a 3-layer topology architecture of the SDE solution is proposed, which consists of Energy Router, Micro dc-grid, and Energy Management Policy Server in the cloud based environment. The analytic reliability model of SDE is conducted and presented. The innovative approach is also applicable in the behind the meter, distributed energy storage and management systems for Industry and Community.

articleTitle: Modeling and control for a three-phase interleaved bidirectional DC-DC energy storage converter
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a bidirectional DC-DC energy storage converter based on interleaved technique is proposed, which can work on continuous charge/discharge mode having greatly enhanced reliability and accuracy for battery energy management. The small signal model of a three-phase interleaved bidirectional DC/DC converter in boost mode is built and analyzed. In order to get a more realistic model, this paper proposed a modeling method that takes the interaction of three-phase current into account. In boost mode, DC/DC converter is controlled to discharge the battery while maintaining the DC bus voltage. In order to reduce the ripple of discharge current, the control strategy consists of phase shift segment. Therefore, the discharge current fluctuation is thereby effectively reduced, which prolongs battery life. Finally, the simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Coordination strategy and its realization of UPFC control protection system and power grid protection for improving fault ride-through capability
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the structure and the fast fault isolation technique of UPFC is introduced firstly, and then a coordination strategy of UPFC control protection system and power grid protection is put forward for improving fault ride-through capability. Based on comprehensively analyzing UPFC control protection system operation, AC protection operation, power gird status and switch position, the most appropriate operation mode of UPFC such as shutdown, switching mode or restarting to the original mode is determined, and that is executed coordinating with AC protection operating by the strategy. As the part of the strategy, the discrimination principle and implementation method of the strategy are represented in detail. The strategy is verified in system commissioning and operation of Western Nanjing 220kV power grid UPFC project and closing-loop test for control protection system of Southern Suzhou 500kV power grid UPFC project. The result shows that the strategy can further improve UPFC fault ride through capability.

Author Keywords: Western Nanjing 220kV power grid UPFC project

articleTitle: Research on the implementation scheme of shunt capacitor protection and monitoring
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The shunt capacitor is used as the reactive power supply, which has the function of regulating the system voltage and improving the quality of the power supply. But shunt capacitor often appears damage phenomenon. The high failure rate of the device capacitor and the occurrence of multiple burst, group of injury problems results in significant fluctuations in the grid voltage, active power and reactive power loss, reducing the service life of the capacitor, affecting the safe operation of power grid. In order to improve the operation reliability of shunt capacitor, the capacitor protection and the monitoring function are integrated, and the capacitance value is calculated by the voltage and current information collected by the relay protection device. And increase the record capacitor harmonic distribution, instantaneous overvoltage and overcurrent condition automatic recording, capacitance capacity change record function, provide diagnosis basis for capacitor fault diagnosis. The proposed capacitor by using capacitor line parameters calculation method has high universality, the actual use of the relay protection device for voltage and current extraction with high accuracy, and calculate the capacitance value of the error is very small, that meet the requirements of protection and monitoring. Recording the harmonic content, overvoltage and overcurrent, the capacitance changes has high value of the capacitor fault research.

articleTitle: A novel control scheme for microgrid inverters seamless transferring between grid-connected and islanding mode
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Microgrid (MG) system in integration with the utility grid is a revolutionizing way of reliable supply to critical loads during utility shutdown or outage. The inverter in this system, responsible for energy interchange between MG and utility grid, has vital importance. A seamless transferring between this inverters' operating modes (grid-connected (GC) and Islanding modes) is a key to the stable system operation. This paper represents a novel control scheme contingent on indirect current control for seamless transferring between these operating modes. Moreover, a proportional integral based software phase-lock loop (PLL) is adopted for synchronization purpose to ensure precise phase lock during mode-switching. Finally, a digital control based experimental prototype of this inverter is designed and built according to the MG requirements to authenticate the proposed control scheme.

articleTitle: LVRT control strategy of VSC-HVDC connected large PV plant
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper investigates a low voltage ride through control strategy of a large scale PV plant that integrated onto the grid via a single terminal VSC-HVDC line. An improved VSC-control scheme, coordinated with the super-capacitor battery controls at the PV plant, is proposed to provide the grid reactive power boost, and to absorb the unbalancing power in the DC grid, to ensure stability of the integrated DC/AC grid. A PSCAD/EMTDC model, which includes a PV plant, a single terminal VSC-HVDC line, an inverter station connected to a transformer, an AC line and then to an infinite source, is created to verify the proposed control strategy. A three phase to ground fault at the inverter station is given as an example, to demonstrate the proposed LVRT control strategy. Extensive simulation tests have provided that the PV plant is able to ride through the fault scenarios while supplying reactive power to the AC grid, and observing no over-voltage over the DC grid and the VSC-HVDC line, providing the proposed LVRT control strategy is feasible and reliable.

articleTitle: Explorative research on harmonic transmission characteristics and corresponding measures of the UHV half-wavelength transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The structure of half-wavelength transmission lines makes its transmission characteristics very unique. Therefore, this paper investigated the half-wavelength transmission lines' harmonic transmission characteristics. Firstly, a simulation model for the half-wavelength lines was established and two typical working conditions were analyzed based on the Frequency Dependent (Phase) Model. Secondly, the harmonic transfer coefficient of short-distance lines was compared to that of the half-wavelength lines. Finally, a harmonic source was put into the half-wavelength transmission system and the voltage distortion rate was compared. The results show that the harmonic transfer coefficients of the half-wavelength lines are different from that of short-distance lines. The voltage distortion rate at the start and the end of the lines shows linear variation with the increase of harmonic number, and the distortion rate shows fluctuation when it is at the middle of the lines. The research can provide technical support for the development of half-wavelength transmission technology.

articleTitle: Linear interpolation process and its influence on the secondary equipment in substations
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Linear interpolation algorithm is widely used to achieve data resampling function in the secondary equipment of digital substations. In order to analyze the transfer characteristics of linear interpolation, this paper presents an equivalent analysis process for the algorithm based on interpolation auxiliary signal. Results show that for sampling frequency conversion, the linear interpolation process performs as a fixed low pass filter. While for data synchronization whose sampling frequency stays unchanged, magnitude of the signal after interpolation depends on the position of the interpolating points. In addition, this paper discusses the influences of linear interpolation on the secondary equipment. It takes little effect on protection equipment. However, it has negative influences on the performance of measurement equipment and merging unit.

articleTitle: Study on the hotspot distribution characteristics of oil immersed transformer based on electromagnetic-fluid-thermal fields coupling analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power transformer is one of the key equipment in power system. The main failure factor of oil immersed transformers is the high temperature generated during operation. Therefore, it is necessary to study the hotspot distribution of iron core and winding temperature of oil immersed transformers. This paper analyzes the tendency of winding, iron core and oil in the course of temperature rise and cooling stage. And the distribution area of hotspot temperature is clear eventually. Three-dimension model of oil immersed transformer is established by the finite element software. And the distribution of temperature can be obtained through the accurate calculation and analysis on the coupling field of electromagnetic-fluid-thermal. The conclusion of electromagnetic analysis is generated into the thermal field model as the pre-additive load in the thermal analysis. The conclusion of thermal characters studied before is verified. And a deeper comprehension of hotspot temperature is obtained simultaneously.

articleTitle: Study on coordinated charging control algorithm for plug-in electric vehicle based on energy internet
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, as an important part of the energy internet, plug-in electric vehicle has got more and more attention around the world. Although the plug-in electric vehicle has short mileage, charging inconvenience and other problems, it has real-time visible running state, convenient communication control, two-way control and other advantages to its great potential for development. And the energy internet is the important foundation to solve the future large-scale electric vehicles scattered and incoordination access to the distribution network and resource sharing. Therefore, how to use the energy internet control platform to response the guide of the peak-valley time-of-use (TOU) power price, and then optimizing the electric vehicle access to the grid charging and discharging, and to maximize the potential of electric vehicles energy storage, has important research significance. Based on the analysis of the present situation of the application of electric vehicles in the energy Internet, this paper proposes a cooperative charging algorithm combining the charging current and giving the preferential or compensated price. The objective function and the optimization model of the coordinated charging control algorithm are defined. Taking the electric vehicle charging station in a typical energy internet as an example, this paper combines the electric vehicle load forecasting curve and the time-of-use price curve to simulate the coordinated charge control algorithm proposed in this paper. The simulation results show that the algorithm can effectively stimulate the interaction between electric vehicle users and power grid and realize the functions of power system peak load filling and emergency power supply; so that electric vehicles become the service terminal in the energy internet, which improve the interactivity, friendliness, and economy of the energy internet.

articleTitle: Optimal configuration of energy storage for distributed photovoltaic generation
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The photovoltaic (PV) power generation grows very rapidly in China. In order to ensure the reliability of PV generation and to maximize the usage of PV resources, it is usually necessary to configure the appropriate energy storage for the distributed PV generation. Based on the load characteristics of different electricity users, the energy storage capacity configuration is established from the interests of power users. The Generic Algorithm (GA) is introduced as the optimization methodology to find the target value to maximize the net present value. The results propose a reasonable energy storage configuration and the charging/discharging strategy. Finally, the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method are verified with an example of a regional distribution network in Jiangsu province. By taking the voltage fluctuation value as an index, the power flow calculation of the IEEE bus-33 system is carried out. The results show that the storage energy can improve the economic benefit of the planning scheme.

articleTitle: Study on effect of DFIG on small signal stability of power system with high share wind power
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Wind power is experiencing rapid development and the share of wind power is increasing fast. The effect on power system small signal stability caused by high share wind power has got more and more concern. At first, the model of mechanical systems and electrical control system of DFIG is established in the simulation software DIgSILENT/PowerFactory. After building IEEE 3-machines 9-buses system, the effect of DFIG on power system small signal stability is simulated. Then, based on the simulation results, the cause that DFIG affect the small signal stability of power system is analyzed. At the last, an improved pitch angle control strategy is put forward. By adding an additional controller, this strategy can indirectly increase the damping of the power system and improve the dynamic stability of power system with high share wind power.

articleTitle: A DC link capacitors' voltage balancing method in unidirectional cascaded H-bridge converter using multi-limb-core (MLC) transformer
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The DC-DC modular cascaded H-bridge topology is being employed in high-/medium-voltage dc grids. The primary problem that may arise in modular converters is capacitor voltage unbalance which may cause module failure. This paper presents a modular cascaded H bridge with transformer isolated DC-DC converter which operates at synchronized half duty cycle. The converter is isolated by a multi-limb-core (MLC) transformer. A control-free and reliable balancing method for capacitors' voltage is proposed. The mechanism of the balancing method has also been presented. Simulation and experimental results are provided as a verification to the feasibility of the proposed voltage balancing method.

articleTitle: Research on differential loss benchmark of power loss management in power supply enterprise
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power loss is an important index to evaluate the benefit of the power enterprise. In this paper, a modified power loss benchmark is proposed to calculate the reasonable power loss in the distribution system. First of all, based on grid divider structure, establish the power facility configuration model according to the distribution network load density. Then, on the basis of the power facility configuration model, establish the economic cost model of power supply, optimization economic power supply radius, making the grid annual operation of the minimum cost. Moreover, calculate the reasonable power loss benchmark. Finally, consider the access of distribution generator, according to the effect of distribution generator on the power distribution, and re-formulate the benchmark. The results of this paper can be utilized to evaluate the power loss status and make the power loss reduction plan for the power enterprise.

articleTitle: Sensorless speed control of PMSM based on improved MRAS method
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, improved model reference adaptive system method has been used for estimating the rotor speed and position in sensorless speed control of surface-mounted permanent magnet synchronous motor. For the parameter variation influence estimation error of the sensorless control strategy, some key parameters are needed to be online identified. We estimated the stator resistance when the motor was starting from a low speed and estimated the rotor magnet flux linkage when the motor was running at medium and high speed. The result shows the sensorless control system works well in the simulation.

articleTitle: Big data and cloud computing platform for energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Energy Internet is a developing trend of electrical power energy industry. The core message is to implement the next-generation of cyber-physical systems shaping future energy industry that is based on a deep merge of operational technology and internet information technology. The growth of energy internet is dependent on the availability of high performance computing and analytics technology to process a massive amount of data set. The paper discusses two core techniques that would support the growth of energy internet, big data and clouding computing, with a focus on the platform architecture that is particularly adaptive to handle a variety of characteristics of energy industry data. Finally, the paper summarizes and proposes a comprehensive, technical solution for energy big data and IoT cloud computing platform with applications focusing on energy consumption monitoring and complementary operation of multi-form energy system that support all aspects within a data lifetime cycle, e.g., acquisition, storage, analytics, and visualization.

Author Keywords: Complementary Operation of Multi-form Energy System

articleTitle: Frequency control in microgrids using electric springs
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The electric spring (ES) is designed to realize the change of the power consumption following the power supply, which can effectively alleviate the active power shortage in the system. It provides a new idea to solve the problem of frequency fluctuation caused by wind turbine connected to the power grid. According to the analysis of ES participating in frequency control, this paper proposes the ES strategy based on phase and amplitude control. Based on this strategy, the controller of ES is designed, which can make ES work in the capacitive mode and inductive mode, respectively, according to different frequency fluctuations. Finally, two cases of single power supply system and microgrid are simulated in MATLAB/Simulink to investigate the effect of ES participating in frequency regulation. The simulation results show the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed model and strategy.

articleTitle: The rapid development of three-phase grid-forming micro-source inverter based on SMC and PI control
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The rapid development process of a proposed three-phase grid-forming micro-source inverter is presented in the paper. Sliding mode control (SMC) and PI control strategies are adopted synthetically to implement the dual closed-loop controller. In order to avoid the repeated selection of control parameters, the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is applied for parameters' optimization. Simulation results certificate the correctness of the proposed controller. And then, the automatic generation of control codes is realized based on the model design method. The actual hardware experiments corresponding to the simulation ones are presented in the paper. The results demonstrate that the inverter based on the rapid development is effective and the proposed controller performs better robustness property over conventional PI-based control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on the combined forecasting method of wind speed
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Wind speed forecasting is very important for the operation of wind power plants and power system. Combined forecasting method is proposed based on the BP neural network and RBF neural network in this paper. The predictive effect indicators are also given. Finally, the wind speed of a certain coastal city in north China is forecasted in 2012. We take two-parameter Weibull distribution to fit actual wind speed data and adopt maximum likelihood method to get relevant parameters. The results show that mean absolute error and root mean square error are reduced by combined forecasting method which takes into account the error precision of BP neural network and RBF neural network. Therefore, we can gain an ideal forecasting effect for wind speed by combined forecasting method.

articleTitle: Reliability assessment of distribution network including distributed generations based on latin hypercube sampling
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The accurate modeling of distributed generation (DG) is the key factor to reliability assessment of distribution network. The paper establishes the random output power model of photovoltaic generation considering capacity, temperature and irradiance. In order to speed up assessment, combining with feeder segment method, the paper applies sequential Monte Carlo simulation based on latin hypercube sampling to reliability calculation of power distribution system with wind turbine generation, photovoltaic generation and battery. Finally, taking the modified IEEE RBTS BUS 6 for example, the paper verifies validity and practicability of the proposed assessment algorithm and model. The influence of different distributed generation on the system reliability indices is also discussed.

articleTitle: Design and experiment of zero-sequence voltage flexible control device for distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The traditional passive arc suppression device can not compensate the active component of single-phase grounding fault current, and its arc suppression effect is limited. A zero-sequence voltage flexible control device was proposed and designed in this paper. It applies DSP+CPLD module to implement the PWM active inverter based on arc suppression technology. Under the normal conditions of network, a specific frequency current signal is injected into network to measure the grounding parameters and calculate the compensation current of grounding fault. And in the single-phase grounding faults conditions, the injection current is generated by the inverter, and injected into the neutral point of network to suppress fault current. The injection current can compensate active component, reactive component and harmonic component of fault current at the same time. Experiment was developed, and results showed that arc suppression effect was obvious and response speed of the device was fast.

articleTitle: Study on the stability of wind-thermal-bundled DC islanded sending end power system
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Wind-thermal-bundled power transmission by UHVDC system is regarded as one feasible way of developing global clean energy in the future and its characteristic of stability should be paid attention to. Different wind-thermal installed capacity ratio is proposed with the wind from the change of power angle and in consideration of the probability for wind power output. The effect of two kinds of proportion on the stability of the sending end islanded system was comparatively analyzed by the simulation. Regulating ability of sending end power would be lower when wind-thermal installed capacity ratio decreased from 1:2 to 1:1.5. Under DC power system disturbances and loss of parts of power, there was a slight increase in ascending amplitude of system frequency, risk of frequency violation will rise accordingly.

articleTitle: Dynamic sorting intelligent charging control strategy of electric vehicles based on time-of-use price
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Uncoordinated charging of large-scale electric vehicles (EVs) would cause charging peak load superimpose on grid peak load, which would affect the economical and safe operation of the power system seriously. Therefore, it is vital to schedule EVs charging behavior. A dynamic sorting intelligent charging control strategy based on time-of-use (TOU) price is proposed in this paper. This strategy is used to reduce the network loss caused by EVs charging, and EVs coordinated charging with charging needs. The charging control strategy is verified in MATLAB/Simulink, and the results show that the strategy proposed in this paper can achieve peak load shifting and improve the economy of the power grid operation.

articleTitle: A sufficient criterion protection principle applied to distribution network integrated with DGs
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High penetration and decentralization rate of distributed generators has brought significant impaction on the distribution network protection. In this paper, a sufficient criterion protection principle is proposed, which extract absolutely selective fault features in fault location judgment of distribution network with DGs. The judgment made by the proposed protection strategy is sufficient and reliable. The principle of the proposed sufficient criterion protection is introduced in detail, and its judgment logic is elaborated. Simulation result validates the reliability and effectiveness of the proposed protection strategy.

articleTitle: Study on optimizing demand response strategy of large scale air conditioning load cluster
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the most important parts of the summer peak load, air conditioning possesses huge potential load adjustment ability in the demand response of (he power system. This paper concentrates on developing this kind of potential to the greatest extent. Considering the load shedding amount and its duration during the system peak period, a new demand response ability index in kW-min, is proposed. The assessment model of large scale air conditioning load cluster to participate in the system demand response is established, based on the advanced discrete particle swarm problem, which aims to maximize the index and constrained by body comfortable satisfactions and normal operation conditions. Finally, results of actual example studies demonstrate the validity of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Study on models simplification of magnetic field around dry-type air-core reactors
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To solve the complicated production process of air-core reactor small-scale model, two-loop and three-loop model have been proposed in this paper to carry out the structure optimization and the prediction of magnetic field. Firstly, according to the size of the air-core reactor, height to diameter ratio(H/D) of the model was divided into 0.5 to 2. The radial and axial magnetic induction strength formulas of the two-loop and three-loop model were obtained. Then the optimal structure of the simplified model was achieved by analytical calculation. The relative height(p) of the optimal simplified model was among the range of 68%~72% when the value of H/D was among the range of 0.5~2.0. Secondly, 3D models were simulated by finite element method to analyze the influence of different simplified model structures on the magnetic field prediction. Finally, the optimal simplified model of origin model was ρ(%)=70.27 three-loop model, and the analytical results were verified.

articleTitle: Multi-objective operation optimization of micro-grid based on electro-thermal coupling constraints
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The concept of the Energy Internet was presented to optimize the utilization of multiple types of energy. This paper mainly focuses on the optimization operation problems of micro-grid under electro-thermal coupling constraints. Based on the electric and thermal energy system models, including CCHP, electro-refrigeration and so on. this paper focuses on improving the thermal network constraints, and establishes the optimization model with electro-thermal coupling constraints. And then, after verifying the effect of 3 types of single objective optimization, this paper carries out multi-objective optimization by using Pareto Front Theory and presents the selection strategy of the corresponding optimized operation plan in the Pareto Front Set.

articleTitle: An optimal method for load restoration in AC-DC system
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A load restoration optimization method in AC-DC system with the consideration of VSC-HVDC is proposed in this paper. Firstly, steady state power flow model of VSC is established. Then, this paper set the maximum capacity and importance of the restoration load as the objective functions, steady state power flow with frequency characteristic as constraint condition. Based on that, the 0-1 programming model with single objective and multi-constraints is established. Furthermore, the model is simplified as one-dimensional knapsack problem with consideration of frequency stability only by adopting the linear programming relaxation method. The results are used as the initial values of the genetic algorithm and the optimal load restoration schemes are finally obtained. At the end of this paper, New England 10-Machine 39-Bus System shows that the proposed method is suitable for complex AC-DC system, which makes up the disadvantage of falling into local optimal solution and slow convergence speed.

articleTitle: Optimal resonance reactive current shielding design in wireless power transfer systems
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Recently, Electric Vehicles (EVs) are widely used in the transportation sector, because they are offering effective solutions for environmental and energy issues. To charge EVs on the road or in the parking, wireless power transfer (WPT) technology is introduced. However, increased use of WPT chargers caused an increase of Electromagnetic field (EMF) exposure to human bodies and Electromagnetic Interference (EMI) with surrounding electronic devices. In this paper, WPT system model is briefly explained and shielding methods used in wireless power transfer systems are discussed. Reactive resonance current loop shielding method is simulated using 3D Finite Element Analysis (FEA) software to design an optimal coils radius for power links and shielding loops. The designed system can transfer up to 12 KW through large air gap of 20 cm with coil-to-coil efficiency of 97.4%. Results show that the reactive resonance current loop method is suitable for using in WPT system for charging EVs which make the charger lighter with high efficiency and low EMF level.

articleTitle: A wide-area protection method based on directional traveling wave energy
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the reliability in traditional traveling wave protection, a wide-area protection method based on directional traveling wave energy was proposed in this paper. Firstly, the association matrix of transmission line/traveling wave protection device was established according to the connection relationship between transmission lines and traveling wave protection devices. Secondly, the fault direction could be identified by calculating the square ratio of positive and negative direction traveling wave energy. Then, the fault association matrix could be obtained by the specific determination principle between the recorded fault direction judgment results and the element in the fault association matrix, the fault line was thus determined. Simulation results showed that the proposed method was not only simple and feasible, but also fast and reliable. The fault line still could be correctly identified when the traveling wave protection device failed to start, the reliability and practicability of traveling wave protection were greatly improved.

articleTitle: Research on insulation life evaluation and thermally induced pyrolysis mechanism of epoxy resin under high frequency electric stresses
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The aging and functional failure of solid insulation materials are the key factors leading to irreversible failures of the gas-solid insulated DC power equipment, such as the voltage source converters. In order to accurately evaluate the insulation lifetime of the DC power equipment under special electric-thermal stresses, especially for the voltage waveform with high steepness, a temperature-controlled high frequency and high voltage test platform for insulation aging is designed, on which the life cycle of epoxy resin at different voltage frequencies (10–50 kHz) and temperatures (80–200 t) is studied. With the Weibull distribution function, the aging life data under various factors are analyzed, and a multi-factor insulation life evaluation formula under the laboratory conditions is proposed. To expound the microscopic mechanism of the frequency-dependent heating effect on the insulation lifetime, reactive molecular dynamic simulation is applied. The formation of the small molecules in the aging process is tracked to reveal the micro-pyrolysis mechanism of epoxy resin. The simulation results demonstrate that during the entire aging process, the gradual cleavage of the epoxy resin will release formaldehyde and acetylene gases, and formaldehyde variation can be utilized as a degradation index of epoxy pyrolysis. The full aging process of epoxy resin is studied from two aspects, namely experiments and microscopic simulation, from which the aging gas characterization parameters are obtained, and an aging life evaluation model is proposed, which presents useful reference for the insulation life study of the DC power equipment.

articleTitle: A short-term wind power prediction approach based on the dynamic classification of the weather types of wind farms
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Wind Power Prediction (WPP) is an effective way to reduce the uncertainty and randomness of large volume of wind power, and to improve the wind power integration capacity of power grid. Recently, WPP based on the classification of weather types is one of the most popular methods to improve the WPP accuracy, but most of the research focused on the static classification of the weather types, and the dynamic classification of weather types is not reported. Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) data of a certain time is applied for the static classification of weather type, which is not effective for describing the dynamic changing process of the weather of wind farms. To overcome the challenge, a short-term WPP approach based on the dynamic classification of the weather types, dividing the weather types into stable type, trending type and fluctuating type, on the basis of wind speed change in a period of time, is presented in the paper. The dynamic classification of the weather types based WPP is with significant advantage to describe the wind power characteristics of different weather types, which is an effective method to improve the short-term WPP accuracy, and is recommended for the industrial applications.

articleTitle: A novel approach to transmission loss rate calculation for electricity transactions
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the advancement of the electricity market reform, electricity can be traded in various forms. At present, the electricity transactions in China are mainly bilateral transactions and pool transactions. The traditional method on transmission loss calculation only get a total transmission loss rate of a certain line, which is not appropriate for bilateral transactions. It is of great significance to research on how to trace transmission losses caused by different transaction components accurately. Firstly, this paper introduces the current calculation method on transmission loss rate in China. Secondly, Diakoptics is adopted to model bilateral transactions through transforming original mesh network into a tree type network. Then, a novel approach to transmission loss rate calculation that can distinguish between bilateral transaction and pool transaction is proposed. In the end, the reasonableness and effectiveness of the proposed approach is validated by an ieee-14-bus standard system.

articleTitle: Estimation of continental renewable energy export potential to support global energy interconnection initiative
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper performs global renewable power export potential analysis to support global energy interconnection initiative. Based on analyzing impact factors including economic factors, political factors, and technical factors, renewable energy export potential is represented as a function of renewable energy production and local energy consumption. For a given future year, renewable energy production and local energy consumption are predicted using historical data. Renewable energy export potential is studied based on global point view. For each continent, renewable energy export potential is calculated. Renewable power flow directions are displayed on world map.

articleTitle: Power system dynamic economic dispatch with wind-solar integration based on particle swarm intelligent searching algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the larger scale of renewable energy sources connected to power system, the power grid operation has to deal with even more uncertainties. It is significant to describe the randomness and intermittence of renewable energy accurately, and take into account the correlation of different renewable energy sources generation. Copula function is proposed to formulate the randomness and correlation of wind-solar power generation in this paper. Based on some important correlation indexes, such as Kendall correlation coefficient, the Copula function can be determined. In order to deal with the stochastic characteristics of wind-solar power generation, the scenario method is proposed to establish the day-ahead dynamic economic dispatch model considering the correlation of wind-solar power generation. The particle swarm intelligent searching algorithm is then introduced to solve it, which is good at overcoming the inherent “curses of dimensionality”. The proposed model and algorithm are finally verified by the IEEE 39-bus system.

articleTitle: Distributed combined cooling heating and power optimization in a microgrid based on collocation method
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Distributed combined cooling heating and power system develops as a novel energy supply way in recent years, which achieves energy cascading utilization, boosts the energy efficiency and is regarded as environment-friendly, economical, and reliable option for the future. The paper first proposes a general methodology called Collocation Algorithm to optimize CCHP performance; second introduces a dynamic model to evaluate CCHP operating cost and combine power network analysis with heating/cooling energy dispatch; and third presents a numerical example to efficiently resolve the resulting stochastic dynamic programming problem. The paper demonstrates results on a simulated data set.

articleTitle: Multi-objective optimization for partitioning scheme of multi-infeed UHVAC/UHVDC system
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the planning and constructing of the UHV grid of China, the receiving-end power grid will receive more and more electric power from ultra high voltage AC/DC (UHVAC/UHVDC) projects, and it is urgent to propose new partitioning method to adapt change from receiving-end power grid. In this paper, combination of community structure theory in complex network and fast non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm (NSGA-II) is applied to grid partitioning for the first time. Firstly, by using the grid partition method of community structure theory, dimension reduction of partition channel is realized. Then, the multi-objective functions considering power flow transferring after AC/DC fault, voltage stability of multi-infeed HVDC system and short-circuit current level of receiving-end power grid are presented. Finally, the NSGA-II algorithm is used to find the Pareto optimal solutions to multi-objective optimization for partitioning scheme. Simulation results of planning power grid verify the validity and rationality of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Realization and application of PSASP-MATLAB associated mixed step simulation based on engine calling mode
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: By calling MATLAB calculation engine function library, associated simulation between Power System Analysis Software Package (PSASP) and MATLAB can be realized in parallel and serial ways. MATLAB could use different timing sequence from PSASP, and mixed step simulation can be realized. This calculation method was used in a 10-nodes power system case for the modeling and simulation of Automatic Voltage Regulator (AVR), and the correctness of the proposed approach is verified. On this foundation, the electromechanical transient model of Static Var Generator (SVG) was founded with MATLAB / Simulink, and it is of universal applicability and transplantability. The inner inverter model can also be used in general grid-connection simulating models of wind power generator, photovoltaic generation, energy storage, etc. Furthermore, simulation and analysis for grid-connected wind farm by introducing the SVG model into PSASP were carried out via the proposed associated simulation method above, and the correctness of the model is verified via the calculation results. The research results can be used to do assistant analysis for reactive voltage of grid-connected new energy power generation.

articleTitle: Harmonic suppression mechanism analysis for wind power grid-connected converter and research on control strategy
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve adaptability for wind power grid-connected converter under non-ideal grid conditions and reduce the harmonic influence, harmonic suppression mechanism for grid-connected converter is depth analyzed and harmonic suppression method and theory is derived. Be limited by complexity of the control system, compound control strategy composed by repetitive controller paralleled with PI controller is proposed for grid-connected converters control in this paper. System stability is analyzed, Geometric representation for repetitive controller stability is shown in figure and Control system difference equation is deduced. Using the proposed control strategy, no difference tracking current control is achieved in the fundamental positive sequence reference frame. The gird current harmonic can be effectively reduced and the converter grid adaptability is improved. The simulation and experimental results verified the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Corrective short-term transmission maintenance scheduling considering post-contingency restoration
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: If partial maintenance is permitted for those maintenance that is not urgent, it will help alleviate emergency conditions through proper restoration strategy. This letter presents a corrective short-term transmission maintenance scheduling model considering post-contingency restoration of some maintenance transmission lines (STMS-PCR), which allows re-scheduling of the maintenance schedules after contingencies. Numerical tests based on six-bus system show that the STMS-PCR method improves the economics and reliability of power system operations.

articleTitle: Control strategy of VSC-HVDC inverter supplying power to the isolated grid with induction motor
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High voltage direct current transmission system based on voltage source converter (VSC-HVDC) can supply power to the weak AC network or the passive network. When the only generator in an isolated grid is out of operation, the isolated grid supplied by VSC-HVDC will become the passive network and the research about how to control the inverter of VSC to ensure safety and stability of the isolated grid during the fault has great importance. In this paper, the transfer function model of passive network is built with considering the inertia of the induction motor. An additional frequency control strategy for VSC-HVDC inverter is proposed in the paper. The performance of VSC-HVDC system supplying power to the active AC network and the passive network with the additional control strategy is simulated in PSCAD/EMTDC. The simulation results verify the correctness of transfer function model and the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Study on magnetic field distribution of turn-to-turn short-circuit of dry-type air-core reactor
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The theoretical approach of theoretical analysis combined with modeling and simulation is proposed to research the key problems such as the magnetic field calculation method of reactor and the influence of turn-to-turn short-circuit fault on coil inductance and spatial magnetic field. Based on the electrical characteristics and equivalent circuit of dry-type air-core reactors (DAR), the equivalent model was established according to Kirchhoffs law and Maxwell's equations. The reactor coil inductance and the spatial magnetic field distribution in view of finite element simulation were established. By comparing the magnetic field distribution of DAR with the axial center axis (ATC) and the radial central axis (LTC) in different positions, the rules about the effect of the turn-to-turn short-circuit fault on the magnetic field were obtained. The result provides the theoretical foundation for the turn-to-turn short-circuit fault detection of DAR.

articleTitle: Single-stage PFC converters for electrolytic capacitor-less LED lamps
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes two novel single-stage power factor correction (PFC) converters for the application of LED driving circuit. These circuits can be implemented free of electrolytic capacitors. Meanwhile, they maintain good power factors and tolerable current ripple rates. Low current ripple rate means low LED light flicker, which is beneficial to human beings' eyes. The proposed circuits are simulated by Powersim. Operation principles and key waveforms are provided in the paper. Simulation results show that the circuits perform well and really have the characteristics we expected.

articleTitle: A novel SoC feedback control of ESS for frequency regulation of fractional frequency transmission system with offshore wind power
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The impact of high penetration of Renewable Energy Source (RES) and the decoupled power-frequency relationship raise the concern for RES participating in the grid frequency regulation. Energy Storage System (ESS) has shown its potential in power system with RES. This paper proposes a new control method of ESS considering the ancillary service efficiency and economical aspects. The proposed state of charge (SoC) feedback control is based on net-zero concept of frequency regulation model. A feedback gain is introduced to satisfy the grid regulations and economical index. The proposed control method is investigated over fractional frequency wind power system, which uses low frequency transmission lines or grids to transmit wind power. Simulations are done in Python and MATLAB/Simulink. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of proposed coordinate control strategy.

articleTitle: Research and application of distributed relay protection test in intelligent substation
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Relay protection play a very important role in the safe operation of substation equipment. The level of relay protection test is very significant for reliable and safe operation of substation. However, the current relay protection test still by handwork, On-site debugging testing requires multiple people, and the test efficiency is below average. We present a method of distributed test of trans - interval relay protection using on-site standby fiber in this paper, and designs a distributed intelligent substation relay protection test device. The device realizes the separation of the relay protection test control and the signal output of the intelligent substation, which makes the cooperative test of the cross-interval relay protection more intuitive and convenient, and is also helpful to improve the field test efficiency.

articleTitle: Probe into micro-grid short-term load forecasting based on method of chaotic time series
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The paper employs chaos theory in electric power system forecasting. The chaos prediction model is established via phase space reconstruction, and a new improved local prediction method is proposed and applied in micro-grid short-term load forecasting. Delay time and embedding dimension are calculated to reconstruct the phase space. The solved maximal Lyapunov exponent reveals the chaotic characteristics of the load time series, and the characteristic difference between the load time series and random series is analyzed through waveform comparison. Historical load data length and sampling interval of daily load are taken into consideration. Daily sampling intervals were taken as 15min, 30min, 45min and 60min, respectively. Finally, the model is applied to forecast actual load data of a certain community in Shaanxi province. Reasonable value range of the data length and sampling interval are given and the results can be taken as one reference for the optimal operation of the actual power grid.

articleTitle: Grid-connected wind turbine group impedance modeling and resonance analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Resonance of Wind power grid is one of the key components for global system resonance. It is a potential threat for power system stable operation. Based on wind grid resonance principle, the grid-connected inverter impedance model is proposed to analysis the resonance of grid-connected wind turbine group. An actual wind farm model and parameters are modeled in MATLAB to calculate the resonance of grid-connected wind turbine group. The impact of wind turbine units number and output power on the resonant characteristics can be analyzed. The correctness of theoretical analysis and effectiveness of the resonance analysis model is supported by experimental results. This is of guiding significance for resonance adjustment of running wind turbines group and grid-connected inverter design.

articleTitle: Fault line selection method for distribution system based on big data and feature classification
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Existing fault line selection methods are not effective enough when faced with complex fault conditions and arc suppression coil grounded systems, because these methods are based on only inaccurate and high-noised current data collected from line outlets. To overcome the defects of the existing methods, a new fault line selection method based on big data and feature classification is proposed. This method maps fault line selection problem as a classification problem, and the fault-related big data are used to train the classifiers. The method includes four successive procedures, namely data preparation, training, classification and evaluation. Data preparation is responsible for data collecting and preprocessing, and training procedure uses processed data to train classifiers. Well-trained classifiers are applied in the classification procedure and the evaluation procedure is responsible for result evaluation. A simulation is conducted in this paper and the results prove that this method works effectively.

articleTitle: Active distribution network protection scheme based on area current direction
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: After the distributed generation is connected to the distribution network, the topology of the unidirectional power supply of the traditional distribution network has been changed, which may lead to the problem of voltage limit and bidirectional power flow. The traditional current protection method is no longer applicable. The fault current characteristics of the inverter interfaced distributed generation under PQ control and the influence of the distributed generation on the traditional current protection technology are analyzed. On this basis, an active distribution network protection scheme based on the area current direction is proposed. The distribution network is partitioned and the fault area is judged by collecting the current fault component direction. The relevant circuit breaker is controlled to complete the isolation of the fault area. Finally, the proposed protection scheme is simulated in PSCAD / EMTDC. The simulation results show the adaptability of the protection scheme to the active distribution network.

articleTitle: Load shifting optimization strategy considering base station energy storage
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The scale of existing communication base stations is large and each base station is equipped with standby energy storage. It is more effective for improving power system operation efficiency to make full use of base station energy storage (BSES). In this paper, a method using BSES to involve in power dispatching is proposed. Firstly, the operation mode of the base station power is introduced and the control strategy of BSES is proposed. Then, the BSES is utilized to participate in load shifting to prove the participation feasibility of large scale BSES in power scheduling. Finally, typical daily load curve of a region is taken as an example and genetic algorithm (GA) toolbox in MATLAB is employed to optimize the model. The results show that the participation of BSES can effectively shift peak load and bring great benefits to the grid.

articleTitle: Risk early warning of distribution power system based on data mining technology
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of distribution network fault analysis and risk early warning research, in this paper, based on the data mining technology, the related factor analysis and risk early warning of distribution network are put forward. Through data cleaning, data transformation, data integration and outliers elimination, this paper sums up 27 kinds of distribution network fault features of the 4 categories. The improved Relief-Wrapper algorithm is used to analyze the fault correlation factors, 6 redundant features are eliminated, and the optimal fault feature subset composed of 21 fault features is formed. Taking into account the frequency of failure and the proportion of the loss of load, the distribution network fault risk indices and risk classification method is proposed. Using Random Forests Algorithm (RFA) method and optimal fault feature subset to carry on the risk early warning. Finally, an example of 120 feeder distribution network is given to verify the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Corrosion fault diagnosis for substation's grounding grid based on micro method
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Corrosion of grounding grid is an important factor in earth-fault. Timely detection of hidden problem of grounding grid can effectively ensure the safe operation of power system and avoid personal injury as well as economical loss by some relevant measurements and fault diagnosis. An improved method is proposed in this paper. First, basic idea and method of fault diagnosis are introduced. We can handle grounding grid as a pure resistance network ignoring the inductance and capacitance of grounding conductor because of their small value. Then, the fault diagnosis equations which are generally nonlinear and underdetermined are established according to theory of circuit. Micro method is used to linearize the equations and solving algorithm is programmed based on simplex method. Finally, a simulation model is created. The result of simulation shows that this method can accurately judge the position of fault branch.

articleTitle: Analysis of the main circuit parameter design method of subsynchronous oscillation suppression device
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Wind power as the representative of large-scale new energy integration is the main form of China's new energy utilization. However, the risk of subsynchronous oscillation caused by the integration of new energy sources is common in large new energy base. It has become an important problem in the safe and efficient operation of large-scale new energy sources. In this paper, the typical wind power and subsynchronous oscillation are described first, and the initial conditions of device design are extracted. Then, the main circuit design of wind power subsynchronous oscillation suppression device is expounded in detail. The connection reactance, module number and module capacitor are deduced theoretically. A set of applicable main circuit parameters is proposed for typical system requirements. Then, an electromagnetic transient model of subsynchronous oscillation suppression device is built based on PSCAD simulation environment, and the design method of the above parameters is verified. The results show that all the indexes meet the expectations and verify the correctness of the parameter design method.

articleTitle: A systemic scheme for improving microgrids' reliability under distribution network fault condition by adopting microgrids-interconnection
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A systemic scheme of electric distribution network restoration using microgrids' interconnection is put forward in this paper. The quantitative feasibility analysis of the proposed scheme mainly contains the judgment based on the risk of low frequency and the discharging time limit of battery energy storage system (BESS). The automatic generation control (AGC) is also applied in the control of interconnection and two control modes, which are FFC-TBC (flat frequency control - tie-line bias frequency control) and TBC-TBC (tie-line bias frequency control - tie-line bias frequency control), based on different operation conditions are put forward. Finally, a simulation example developed in PSCAD/EMTDC proved the correctness and efficiency of the detailed restoration process and control strategy.

articleTitle: Investigation on restoration skeleton and partitioning optimization algorithm for isolated grid after blackout
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to restore the isolated grid in black state rapidly, the grid can be divided into several partitions which are restored in parallel. Given this background, this paper aimed at the rapidity and stability of the restoration, comprehensively considering isolated grid partitioning strategy and the restoration skeleton, proposing a new optimization algorithm for isolated grid partitioning.
