The algorithm makes the shortest starting time of unit as the objective function, constructed by the active power and reactive power balance of the partition zone to simplify a complex multi-objective nonlinear programming problem as a single-objective and multi-constrained linear programming problem, which improves the implementation of optimized design. Finally, New England 10-Machine 39-Bus System is used as an example to verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Stochastic operation optimization of grid-connected photovoltaic microgrid considering demand side response
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the face of the upcoming pressure of energy crisis and environmental problems, the use of solar photovoltaic (PV) power generation has become one of the focuses of the human being. An optimal operation method for photovoltaic microgrid under uncertainty is studied based on the demand side response mechanism in this paper. Monte Carlo simulation is used to simulate the uncertainty of PV and load. The demand side response mechanism is introduced to control the peak load and valley load transfer. Then a chance constrained programming based optimal operation model of PV microgrid is built. The model takes maximum absorption of PV power generation as the objective. The particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve this optimization problem. The simulation results prove the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Evaluation of prediction choice in economic dispatch with uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The unavoidable wind power forecast error results in the pervasive uncertainty in power system economic dispatch. In order to solve optimization problem such as economic dispatch with random variables, the commonest and simplest method is using a deterministic value to replace this random variable. Several kinds of predictions are used such as maximum-likelihood approximation, expectation and median. This study analyses the effect of these prediction choices on uncertainty of power system via comparing their statistical consistency. It is shown that when the wind power output is very volatile, the quality of these prediction choices is not guaranteed. Additionally, a simplified three-unit thermal system and a ten-unit system are studied for illustrating the consequence of statistical inconsistency.

articleTitle: Microgrid coordination control based on H∞ performance index
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Robust stability is one of the core indicators of microgrid control. The difficulties and hot spots in the research of microgrid coordination control is how to ensure the load of microgrid is reasonably distributed according to the rated capacity of distributed generation(DG) and make guarantee DG can also coordinated operation when some interference in the microgrid. In this paper, an improved droop control based on P-f/Q-dU/dt is proposed to ensure that the load is distributed according to the rated capacity of DG. By introducing the sensitivity minimization problem, the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance index is constructed and the microgrid model is transformed into standard H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> control problem, which improves the robust stability of the microgrid. The simulation experiment verifies the correctness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A DFIG wind turbine low-voltage ride-through control strategy based on resynchronization of rotor side converter
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The paper analyzes the impact on doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) and converter during grid voltage dips, presents a control strategy of resynchronization of rotor side converter (RSC). The proposed strategy gives the method of switching between the rotor converter and crowbar circuit to achieve DFIG low voltage ride through (LVRT). For the issue of stator flux observer on rotor converter grid-resynchronization control, the paper puts forward a modified method based on a stator back-EMF integration. The simulation and experimental results validate the proposed LVRT strategy can achieve DFIG system uninterrupted operation during voltage dips.

articleTitle: DC fault current-limiting and isolating technique for the MMC-based DC system
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: DC fault isolation is the key problem in the flexible dc system. At present the dc circuit breaker which could operate fast enough with a large fault current is still unavailable. Based on the dc fault transient characteristics in the dc system based on the modular multilevel converter (MMC), a feasible isolating method was developed by improving the topology of the MMC, which limits the dc-side cable current to a lower level and then interrupts the fault circuit by a dc load switch. Comparisons between different isolating methods show the superiorities of the proposed method. Simulation tests were carried out using MATLAB/Simulink and the feasibility of the proposed isolating method was demonstrated.

articleTitle: A DC fault protection scheme for half-bridge sub-module based MMC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The widely used half-bridge sub-module (HB-SM) topology in modular multi-level converter based HVDC systems (MMC-HVDC) is vulnerable to DC-side faults. The dual thyristor switch scheme (DTSS) eliminates the freewheeling effect and allows dc-link fault current decaying to zero freely, but it has the disadvantages of slow isolation speed and high overcurrent level. This paper proposes a new fault isolation method based on improved redundant sub-module topology and DTSS. With the new added thyristors and IGBT, the capacitor in the redundant sub-module can be quickly fed into the DC fault circuit to reduce the fault current peak and accelerate the fault current decay rate. Finally, simulation tests in PSCAD/EMTDC verifies that this approach realizes a substantial increase in the fault isolation speed and a significant decline of the DC overcurrent level without tripping AC circuit breakers, which provides the prerequisites of rebuilding the dc-link voltage and restarting power transmission.

articleTitle: The prospect of wind and solar power development in the Philippines
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The Philippines is a country with abundant renewable energy resources but relying on imported fossil fuel in a large quantity, one of the national policies is to encourage and accelerate renewable energy development for realizing self-sufficiency on energy supply. This paper presents, by taking wind and solar power as example, the status quo, policies, challenges and prospect of Philippine renewable energy development for sharing practice and experience in such a developing and emerging country.

articleTitle: Protection configuration for the start-up testing of series transformer in UPFC
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For the special start-up testing method and energizing path of series transformer in the UPFC, a temporary protection configuration method is proposed for the start-up testing. With energizing mode, the two-stage temporary overcurrent protection is setup to the valve-side breaker of shunt transformer to protect the series transformer as energizing, and the method for fault current calculation and protection setting is proposed based on the equivalent circuit of series transformer. What's more, a series transformer energizing function of UPFC protection is provided, which include: the differential protection is setup to the valve-side connecting lead between the shunt transformer and series transformer, and the inter-trip protection function is designed to isolate the series transformer and trip the power source under the condition of the series transformer weak fault. Finally, the simulations with fault on charged region are conducted, which is indicated that is can satisfy sensitivity and speed of protection. The protection configuration can be implemented in the field.

articleTitle: Research on estimation probability power flow calculation of distribution network considering distributed generation
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Distribution network is from the passive network into an active network when distributed generation (DG) accesses. It makes the traditional distribution network power flow calculation becomes more complex. According to the common grid-connected mode of distributed generation, considering the random characteristics of distributed generation, analyzed the influence of distributed generation on distribution network. The probability model of PV arrays and wind farms in power flow calculation is constructed, and the probability power flow calculation of distribution network with distributed generation is realized by point estimation method. Finally, the simulation is carried out by IEEE RBTS Bus6 system.

articleTitle: A novel unit commitment model considering electric heating load and its effects on wind power integration
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: It is inevitable for traditional coal-burning heating approach to be replaced by cleaner means. Particularly, electric heating is being vigorously promoted in some countries including China. Due to the good complementary features between heat and electric power, electric heating load can be regarded as a dispatchable resource that improves the flexibility of power systems. This paper proposes a novel unit commitment model incorporating electric heating load as a type of demand response. The dispatch of electric heating load is optimized together with the schedule of generation units. A numerical study is carried out based on the IEEE 30 Bus system, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed model. Results indicate that the total operation cost and carbon emission of power system can be reduced, and more wind power generation can be integrated, as a result of the optimal utilization of electric heating load demand response with this model.

articleTitle: Optimized positioning of IDU at active medium and high voltage distribution networks using DPSO algorithm
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In active distribution network (ADN), intelligent distribution unit (IDU) can monitor and measure the system accurately. IDU forms the hybrid measurement system with remote terminal unit (RTU) and advanced metering infrastructure (AMI). It is significant to improve the accuracy of state estimation. This paper proposed a method to optimally place IDU at HV and MV distribution in order to improve the estimation of the grid state and ensure the efficiency of the system. First, all elements of Jacobian matrix became constant based on the P-Q decomposition method. The multi-objective function was the minimal the error of state estimation error and the cost associated to the IDU, using AHP to determine the weight coefficients. Then discrete optimization swarm optimization (DPSO) was proposed to solve the optimal problem. Tests performed on IEEE 34-bus system, the results illustrated that the algorithm can get the best installation number and optimal placement of IDU according to application scenario requirements. The optimal scheme could effectively reduce the error of state estimation in hybrid measurement system.

articleTitle: A dynamic adaptive algorithm for statistical up-scaling based short-term wind power prediction of regions
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Wind Power Prediction (WPP) of regions is beneficial for the department of power grid dispatching to evaluate the wind power output characteristics from a global perspective and to formulate a scientific and reasonable scheduling scheme for power grid. The statistical up-scaling based WPP of regions is one of the most popular methods, which has been widely applied by the industrial companies. The selection of reference wind farms is one of the key factors of the statistical up-scaling method based WPP of regions. However, most of the methods for the selection of reference wind farms are not flexible, which restrict the improvement of the WPP accuracy, as the weather of wind farm sub-regions are always changeable. To overcome the challenge, a dynamic adaptive algorithm based WPP of regions is presented in the paper, in terms of the dynamic selection of reference wind farms, the dynamic selection of the WPP methods based on the classification of the weather types of the wind farms and the dynamic selection of the up-scaling method. The results show that the proposed method is with higher accuracy than the traditional statistical up-scaling based WPP of regions and is applicable for industrial WPP of regional wind farms.

articleTitle: A calculation method of saturated load based on short-circuit current constraint
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Saturated load is city's maximum affordable load, which is very important for urban development planning. As the power grid matures, the short-circuit current gradually becomes the key factor affecting the security of power grid, it is urgent to analysis the saturated load based on grid technology constraint of short-circuit current. In the paper, firstly, the regular pattern of power supply partition is put forward. Secondly, the typical partition structure model is extracted and the relationship between the model parameters and the actual power supply is deduced. Furthermore, a new method of calculating the saturated load level of power grid is proposed with the consideration of different partition structures and different power supply growth modes. Finally, the saturated load of an actual grid is calculated and the accuracy and effectiveness of the method is verified.

articleTitle: A new method to suppress the limit cycle of PWM Inverter
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Digitally controlled PWM inverters are interfered by quantization errors caused by A/D converters (ADC) and Digital Pulse-Width Modulators (DPWMs), which may result in undesirable limit-cycle oscillations (LCO). In this paper, static and dynamic models that include the quantization effects are derived and used to explain the origins of LCO. According to a brief analysis of the limit cycle oscillation period and amplitude, a new method to improve digital PWM resolution is introduced in the paper. By this method, the limit cycle can be avoided with the proposed integral part so that it will not propagate to the output directly. Therefore the digital PWM resolution is improved largely. In the end, the conclusions are illustrated by simulation and experimental examples.

articleTitle: Discussion on intelligent operation and maintenance of large distributed master station system
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In allusion to the current situation of smart distribution grid and AMI system operation and control, this paper analyzes the problems existing in the operation and control of the smart distribution grid and AMI system in the province and the wider deployment. Based on the experience of the operation and control of various distributed systems in the IT field, this paper proposes an application framework for the operation and control of smart distribution grid and AMI system which is suitable for large-scale deployment and complex structure. This paper describes the implementation of the framework from the aspects of functions, implementation methods, standards and systems. The application prospect of the operation and control framework of the super large scale power system is analyzed.

articleTitle: Rapid calculation of static voltage stability under branch outage based on Z-index in wind farms
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Based on local voltage stability index L, this paper proposes a quick method to calculate the voltage stability index under branch outage. Using the power flow equations and status information of pre-contingency case, the middle state is established between original network and N-1 network through substitution theorem and the sensitivity of voltage stability index, to deduce the algorithm of post-contingency static stability index about pre-contingency injected power under different branch outage. The results in IEEE14-bus system including wind power generation show its feasible and effective.

articleTitle: A self-tuning frequency stability control strategy using virtual synchronous generator
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the field of power electronic inverter control, the virtual synchronous generator (VSG) technology has been fully studied as the main means to improve the stability of power system in recent years. And the stability of the system power grid frequency is improved by solving the problem of the inertia of the distributed energy grid-connected system. However, when the power network strength changes, the original VSG control strategy can not maintain the system frequency stability. In order to further improve the effect of VSG on frequency stability, this paper analyzes the frequency stability of VSG system when the strength of power network is changed, and studies the factors that affect the change of power network strength. Based on above study, a self-tuning frequency stability approach is investigated. This proposed control strategy considerably improves the stability performance of frequency for the situation in which the strength of the power network changes. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by Matlab/ Simulink simulation tool.

articleTitle: Research of double Y shift 30° PMSM two-motor series-connected system based on adaptive back-stepping method
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The double Y shift 30° PMSM two-motor series-connected system is supplied by one single inverter, which PMSM1 operates on dq plane and PMSM2 operates on zizi plane. To overcome the poor robustness and improve static and dynamic performance of adaptive back-stepping control approach suitable for the two-motor series-connected system is researched. And the adaptive back-stepping controller of PMSM1 is deduced on dq plane. The simulations compared with back-stepping controller show that adaptive back-stepping can improve the dynamic and static performances.

articleTitle: Mechanism and characteristics of photovoltaic power generation operation
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Photovoltaic cells are often obscured by the shadow and produce power mismatch in practical application. This paper adopts a series of photovoltaic cells with bypass diodes and parallel photovoltaic cells with blocking diodes to establish the model of photovoltaic cells in order to reduce the power loss caused by mismatch. The research shows that the series of photovoltaic cells with bypass diodes can divide current and the parallel photovoltaic cells with blocking diodes can prevent the reverse flow of the current effectively. Both of them can reduce the power loss caused by the mismatches to a certain extent. But they also cause the multi-peak power curves, which cause a lot of inconvenience for maximum power tracking.

articleTitle: A novel three-phase unbalanced overvoltage suppression method for distribution network
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at suppressing three-phase unbalanced overvoltage in distribution network, a new suppression method was proposed in this paper. The PWM active inverter is used to inject a current with the amplitude and phase easily obtained into the neutral point of distribution network. The optimal injection current only need to record the amplitude and phase of the neutral point voltage at the initial moment of the three-phase unbalance, and takes it as a reference. After injecting the optimal injection current, the neutral point voltage can be suppressed to 0, i.e., the purpose of three-phase unbalanced overvoltage suppression can be achieved. Simulation analysis showed that it has the fast response, and it can effectively suppress the three-phase unbalanced overvoltage, which verified the feasibility and validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on fault location method of VSC-MTDC power grid
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Fault location technology of multi-terminal flexible DC power grid is the key technology to ensure the safe and reliable operation of DC power grid. In this paper, multi-terminal flexible DC power gird consisting of two-level voltage source converter is regarded as an object. In the research of fault location method, fault section is confirmed firstly before fault location. Due to the fault circuit and DC side large capacitance, the voltage change rate of the DC capacitor at the outlet of the converter in the fault interval is different from none fault interval. According to the characteristics above, the method is used to determine the fault section, which compares the DC capacitor discharge voltage change rate of the VSC outlet side in fault interval with none fault one. The method is verified through the simulation in MATLAB/Simulink, and it's feasible and valid comparing with the existing ones.

articleTitle: PSCAD simulation of 500kV UPFC applied receiving-end power grid
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As a dynamic power electronic device, 500kV unified power flow controller (UPFC) is applied to control the power flow of transmission lines and optimize the distribution of feeding power into receiving-end grid. Meantime, UPFC is able to provide system with instant reactive power support. In this paper, effect of 500kV UPFC on HVDC feeding power grid is conducted through electromagnetic transient simulation. AC/DC system, UPFC device and control system including reactive power response strategy are built detailed in PSCAD, which is according to the dynamic characteristic of UPFC shunt side. Results show that UPFC can improve the voltage stability of HVDC feeding system and relieve nearby DC commutation failure problem.

articleTitle: Active distribution network protection mode based on coordination of distributed and centralized protection
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Based on the idea of hierarchical and modular structure, the protection system structure for coordination of distributed and centralized protection is constructed. First of all, the distributed protection uses the multi-source information provided by the electric quantity information and the logic quantity information to judge the feeder state, and makes the protection adapt to the operation condition of the intermittent distributed power supply. Then, according to the characteristics of multi-source information redundancy, the centralized protection uses multi-source information fusion technology to enhance the fault tolerance of the protection scheme, and achieve fine fault location and power supply restoration. Finally, under different fault scenarios, the distributed protection and centralized protection are used to analyze the interaction process of active distribution network caused by random load and intermittent distributed power supply. Simulation results show the effectiveness and correctness of the proposed active distribution network protection mode based on coordination of distributed and centralized protection.

articleTitle: Research on harmonic suppression strategy of inverters in microgrids
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Increasing use of power electronic components in inverter brings a lot of harmonics, which seriously affects the power quality of microgrid. An improved three-phase voltage source inverter is proposed according to the study of harmonic suppression control strategy of inverter. The second order generalized integrator can track current signal quickly and suppress signal noise. Therefore, a method uses the second order generalized integrator to synthesize virtual harmonic impedance is proposed. This method is applied in traditional double loop control to reduce harmonic content of inverter output voltage. In order to improve the control effect, the quasi-PR controller is used to replace traditional PI controller in voltage control loop. Finally, this paper builds a system model by Matlab/Simulink. The simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively reduce the harmonic voltage and improve the power quality.

articleTitle: Real-time reconstruction of multi-area power system signals based on compressed sensing
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the growing complexity of the power systems, increasing quantity of signals needs to be transmitted in multi-area power networks. In the light of the traditional signal acquisition process, Shannon sampling theorem need to be contented to prevent signal distortion, so the transmission of massive information requires large bandwidth. The timely and accurate transmission of real-time signal poses great challenges to multi-area power systems. This paper puts forward a novel signal processing means for the real-time reconstruction of multi-area power system signals via compressed sensing. Compressed sensing is an effective approach for acquiring compressed signals at a sampling rate remarkably below the Nyquist rate and accurately reconstructing signals from measurement vector. Multi-area power system signals needs to be sparsely transformed using sparse basis before being compressed. This paper uses an over-complete dictionary as the sparse basis. It can better match the structure of signal and achieve better sparse representation. In addition, this paper utilizes a temporality multiple sparse Bayesian learning (TMSBL) algorithm for improved reconstruct signal. Simulation results demonstrate that the signal can be accurately reconstructed applying the advanced modus while significantly reducing the signal reconstructed time.

articleTitle: Adequacy evaluation of offshore wind farm considering wake effect
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the process of modeling offshore wind farms, it is important to establish an accurate model of wind speed as it is relevant to the power output of the wind turbine generator (WTG). In an offshore wind farm, due to the units are intensively located, the influence of wake effect cannot be neglected. The wake effect is related to many factors, such as wind speed, wind direction and the platoon of WTGs. In this paper, a wind power output model considering wake effects is proposed for power systems reliability evaluation. By analyzing the influence of partial occlusion and the wake effect on the complex wind turbines, a model of partial shield wake effect considering complex terrain is established. By using MATLAB, the input wind speed is calculated under different wind speed, wind direction and fan arrangement, and the fast modeling of wind farm under the change of wind speed and direction is simulated. The model can more accurately describe the change when the wind speed and direction of wind farms output power. The correctness of the method is verified by simulation. The method is transplantable and can be used to calculate the input wind speed model of wind farms in various scales. Theoretically, by setting up multiple offshore wind locations, the intermittency and randomness of the integrated output can be reduced. The power outputs from multiple offshore wind locations are also investigated in this study.

articleTitle: Quantitative infrared spectrum detection of SF6 decomposition components based on principal component regression analysis
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The quantitative analysis of SF6 gas decomposition components is of great significance to the online monitoring and fault diagnosis of gas insulated switchgear (GIS) equipment. There is a problem that the absorption coefficient is difficult to determine and the multi-component detection is complicated in infrared quantitative analysis. To solve the problem, the infrared quantitative algorithm based on principal component regression analysis was used and the decomposition components of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, SOF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and their absorption peaks were selected as the objects to study. The algorithm uses the spectral data as the input and the gas volume fraction as the output establishing the direct correspondence between the absorption spectrum and the concentration. A sample of three characteristic components was prepared. The spectral data were obtained from the training samples and the infrared quantitative prediction model was established according to the algorithm. By comparing the effect of the principal component regression analysis algorithm and the fitting method, it is shown that the regression algorithm is more accurate than the fitting method. The prediction results of the test samples and the measured data show that the algorithm and the forecasting model have good application value.

articleTitle: Mechanism analysis of generalized oscillation caused by the integration of renewable energy generation
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Occurrence of oscillation phenomena on generalized frequency band caused by renewable energy generation (REG), which connects to power grid in the way of power electronic convertors, is analyzed. The eigenvalue analysis method is adopted to assess stability of a voltage source control inverter-fed ac system based on state space model. In detail, for the inverter, a comprehensive model covering power controller, outer voltage loop and inner current loop is established. Then combining inverter model with network and load model to establish overall state space model. By studying the characteristics of the eigenvalues distribution, useful information on the nature and extent of the generalized frequency oscillation can be found. Moreover, participation analysis is presented to evaluate the contributions of state variables to these oscillation modes. The root locus results validate the theoretical analyses.

articleTitle: Real-time distributed grounding fault monitoring and control system considering human safety
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Electric shock accidents caused by single-phase fault in distribution often occur in China, as for it, a real-time distributed grounding fault monitoring and control system is put forward in this paper. First, after considering the probability of ventricular fibrillation when people exposed to an electrical shock, a human safety current is proposed. Then a variable frequency current signal is injected into the neutral in network, the system to ground parameters are calculated after finding the harmonic frequency, which are used to detect ground fault; when fault detected, the fault phase voltage is controlled by the preset injecting current calculated by parameters measured before, meanwhile the fault current is compensated as well (patent number 201710544976.9). Experiments show the high accuracy of real-time harmonic measurement, and simulation proves the system can suppress the fault current in the range of human safety current.

articleTitle: Chronological simulation study of wind power consumption with consideration of secure unit commitment constraints
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Large scale wind consumption capability is influenced by generation mix, load characteristics, transmission network deliverability and even wind power characteristics. This paper performed chronological simulation with consideration of secure unit commitment constraints to study wind power consumption of a test system in North China. Case study indicates that the most challenging time period of wind power consumption is winter night especially during the Spring Festival when the load is very low and generation output cannot be decreased to meet heating needs.

articleTitle: Dynamic model of reutealis trisperma production as biodiesel feedstock in Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The increasing of energy demand, the limited reserves of fossil fuel and the awareness of clean environment have led to find another alternative energy for these problems. Biofuel is one of alternative of renewable energy from living organism. Based on its form, biofuel can be classified into bioethanol, biodiesel and biogas. The research is focusing on biodiesel to replace diesel oil, which derived from Reutealis Trisperma. Currently, Indonesia produced all of biodiesel from Crude Palm Oil (CPO). Unlike CPO, Reutealis Trisperma does not threat the food security because it is a non-edible plant. It can be cultivated on wide variety of land and has high potency as biodiesel feedstock. The research purposes to assess and to utilize the Reutealis Trisperma production as biodiesel feedstock for Indonesia by constructing a system model for the biodiesel production with related variables such as land, productivity, conversion efficiency, biodiesel demand and others, using Dynamic System Modeling. It also illustrates the projection of biodiesel production from Reutealis Trisperma and CPO. The scenario of pilot project of Reutealis Trisperma, which will be planted in several districts in West Java, and it will give the projection from 5-25 years of cultivation, starting from 2017. The result shows that Reutealis Trisperma and CPO will produce biodiesel sufficiently fulfilling the demand. Furthermore, in the year of 2028 as Reutealis Trisperma productivity increases, biodiesel demand will be fully supplied by biodiesel from Reutealis Trisperma.

articleTitle: Unified identification of power and gas faults for integrated electricity and natural gas energy system
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Regardless of the failure in the power system or in the natural gas system, it will threaten the operation of the integrated electricity and gas energy systems. In view of the lack of current research on the unified identification of the fault in the integrated system, a fault identification and location method based on big data analysis is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the dynamic model of the natural gas pipeline is established, and then the typical characteristics of the integrated system collected by the intelligent terminal are extracted, and the heterogeneous characteristics are merged into the high-dimensional matrix in space and time. The matrix is analyzed by multi-dimensional analysis and local outlier factor. Finally, the fault identification and location in the integrated electricity and gas energy systems are carried out according to the LOF value and the node correlation. A generalized node is also set up to prevent misoperation caused by intelligent equipment faults. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by using Simulink model.

articleTitle: Distributed economical dispatch for renewable power system with time-varying topology and fluctuating power generations
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the limitations in centralized economical dispatch (ED), a distributed algorithm is properly designed by selecting generator incremental costs as the consensus variables in this paper to solve the ED problem in a center-free manner. The proposed distributed algorithm is more effective than the conventional central one in the situation that the topologies are time-varying. In addition, the convergence rate, as an important performance indicator of distributed algorithm, is also investigated for different communication topologies in this paper. Considering wind power generation with relatively large fluctuations, the proposed algorithm has been tested on a 10-generator system with fluctuating wind power generations, and the simulations have demonstrated the effectiveness of the distributed ED algorithm for power system ED with time-varying power generations and topologies.

articleTitle: Hardware-in-the-loop simulation of wind turbine based on 6 degree-of-freedom load
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Wind turbine simulator (WTS) makes the research of wind power generation technology in laboratory possible. However, only 1 degree-of-freedom (DoF) simulations of the wind turbine are studied by most researchers, and they can't imitate the actual comprehensive situations. Therefore, the effects of interactions between electrical and mechanical aspects are not accurately taken into account. This paper proposed a scheme to imitate the output characteristic of the real wind turbine by using a load application system (LAS). In this test system, it is possible to apply the load in all 6 DoF with the help of LAS unit. The test platform is equipped with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) to investigate system level interactions between electrical and mechanical aspects. Finally, an experimental platform is established and the feasibility and effectiveness of the scheme are proposed.

articleTitle: Study of energy distribution based on basic topological index of power
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Transmission capacity is an important indicator to evaluate the reliability of a power grid. Spatial Characteristic Length Ratio (SCLR) is one of the transmission capacity indexes which combines the complex network theory into the power system and can reflect the transmission capacity. In this paper, take a complex network considering characteristics of power system, an improved topology network model of power system is proposed. The relationship between the network topology index and grid transmission capacity is defined and calculated. Some general rules for describing grid transmission capacity are obtained. The correctness and feasibility of the proposed method are proved by simulation.

articleTitle: Gearbox fault diagnosis method based on heterogeneous information feature fusion
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a fault diagnosis method based on heterogeneous information feature fusion is proposed to overcome the limitation of the single fault signal of wind turbine and the characteristics of fault characteristics. This method uses the collected vibration signal, speed signal, temperature signal, pressure signal and electrical signal as the original source, respectively extracting the kurtosis, wavelet packet frequency, speed, gearbox inlet temperature, fuel tank temperature, heater temperature, bearing temperature, gearbox pump pressure, inlet pressure, and power as the eigenvalue. Considering the correlation between eigenvalues, the principal component analysis is used to reduce the fusion of the original eigenvalues, and the feature quantity is obtained. The fusion feature is patterned by neural network optimized by genetic algorithm. The simulation results show that the proposed method has higher diagnostic accuracy than the similar information feature fusion method.

articleTitle: Modeling and control of a mutual support hybrid AC/DC micro-grid
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Micro-grid is a distribution subnet which has a certain degree of control capabilities and self-regulation, including distributed generation, energy conversion device, load monitoring and protection device. Hybrid AC/DC micro-grid is an ideal and powerful topology model in the process of development of diversification and low cost for the distributed generation, the distribution network and the loads. In this paper, aiming at the access and control applications for the high density distributed power and loads in the hybrid AC/DC distribution network in the future, a new mutual support hybrid AC/DC micro-grid topology structure is proposed. Meanwhile, a corresponding simulation model is established. Based on this, stability of proposed hybrid AC/DC micro-grid system is studied. Finally, simulation results further verified the correctness of the model of hybrid AC/DC micro-grid and the feasibility of the proposed scheme of hybrid AC/DC micro-grid.

articleTitle: Prediction of dynamic response of semi-submersible floating offshore wind turbine using Morison's equation and fully coupled nonlinear model
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A fully coupled nonlinear simulation tool using an augmented Morison's equation is developed to predict the dynamic response of floating offshore wind turbine (FOWT) system. The hydrodynamic coefficients of a semi-sub model are numerically predicted by using large eddy simulation with volume of fluid method. Firstly, normal and axial distributed hydrodynamic coefficients for each member of the semi-sub model are predicted and the integrated coefficients are validated by water tank tests. Then, the performance of the simulation tool in the prediction of dynamic response of FOWT under different sea states is investigated. Finally, modelling of mooring system is studied to predict the mooring fairlead tension. The dynamic responses of FOWT with improved hydrodynamic models agree well with those measured in water tank tests.

articleTitle: Analysis of typical configuration scheme of micro-grid based on the electric energy router
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The electric energy router (EER) could provide more flexible control means of power flow for micro-grid. In this paper, we focus on the key issues of micro-grid configuration. First, 3 typical micro-grid configurations based on EER are proposed. To assess the typical configuration schemes, 4 kinds of assessment indexes are introduced, which include local consumption capacity of renewable energy, energy loss, operation cost and Life Cycle Cost (LCC) of micro-grid. A thorough analysis for these configuration schemes based on the typical scenarios has been carried out. Then the impact factors on the configuration are investigated in the assessment and the conclusions could be the useful references for optimizing configuration of micro-grid based on ERR.

articleTitle: Global energy interconnection based optimal power systems planning — A global perspective 2016–2050
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: On the basis of an overview of world's energy situation and the outlook of the renewable generation and high voltage transmission techniques, a global energy interconnection (GEI) construction is proposed, which can achieve the global energy and electricity exchange. For the proposed GEI system, the power delivery potentials for main large-scale renewable energy power generation bases located in different continents are analyzed. In this paper, the concept of “interconnection risk” is introduced to describe the impact of changes in political risk and international situation on the transmission cost for the first time. With the objective of minimum power supply cost, a quantitative assessment model describing interconnection risk and an optimal power planning framework for GEI system are established. Finally, a sensitivity experiment is conducted to analyze the impact of kinds of uncertainties on the optimal power systems planning schemes.

articleTitle: Research on peak load regulation capacity planning for long-term market
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Insufficient power capacity for peak load regulation has caused loss of wind power accommodation in China. A regulation capacity market is under consideration to encourage more peak regulation service, thus how much the market would be is important for each participant. A new peak-load regulation capacity planning method is proposed for long-term market based on the wind power curtailment evaluation model using probabilistic production simulation. The method is suitable for the situation in the planning stage without the knowledge of detailed sequences of load and renewable power, and includes modeling of two peak load regulation measures, increasing the adjustable capacity and to shift some long-lasting units to on/off cycling units. A typical area in China is studied in the paper to evaluate the actual effects of different measures.

articleTitle: Daily load curve forecasting using factor analysis and RBF neural network based on load segmentation
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The short-term daily load forecasting plays an important role in active and reactive power scheduling for power system. Aiming at the shortcomings that minute load fluctuation is not considered, a new daily load curve forecasting using factor analysis and RBF neural network based on load segmentation is proposed. Based on the precise prediction of 288-point daily load curve, normalized load curve segmentation method is used to segment the original load curve which reduces the number of segments and the demand of samples. To reduce the dimension, factor analysis is utilized to develop a few and independent common factors which characterize common features of daily load curve. Considering the load correlation, the RBF neural network model is established for each common factor, and then the minute daily load curve can be restored from the forecasted common factors. Case studies based on the historical load data of the actual substation in Shantou are provided to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An equivalent method for the fault circuit current analysis of DFIG wind farm
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For the doubly fed induction generator (DFIG) wind farms, the fault characteristics are complex, transient characteristics of fault and short-circuit current simulation analysis is crucial, so it's important to set a new model which is applicable to the equivalence of the transient fault. In this paper, a novel fault transient equivalence method for wind farm based on rotor current peak cloud model is proposed. The numerical characteristics of cloud droplet sample are calculated through the improved backward cloud generator. The cloud droplet sample of rotor current peak value can be obtained under random wind speed and terminal voltage drop. The wind turbine generators can be clustered by the feature indices through the k-means cluster algorithm. A multi-machine equivalent model is established. Based on power loss method and weighted voltage difference method, the network transformation method is proposed, which can realize the transformation of different circuit structure, and is suitable for the aggregation of unit at any position. Reliability and effectiveness of the proposed scheme are verified by simulation results. It also provide the support for analyzing and calculating the short-circuit current and relay protection of wind farm.

articleTitle: Large scale integration of EVs into the grid and its potential effects on power system reliability
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A distributed smart charging algorithm is introduced in this paper to coordinate the stochastic charging behaviors of large amounts of electric vehicles (EVs). Each EV has some level of intelligence and communication abilities to make charging decisions to achieve its own maximum benefits. Meanwhile, the EV aggregators use the smart pricing and sequential price update mechanisms to influence the charging behaviors of EVs. A binary hybrid GSA-PSO algorithm is used to solve each EV's charging optimization problem. The potential effects of large scale integration of EVs on power system reliability is also discussed. Numerical case studies show this distributed smart charging algorithm is able to effectively transfer the EV charging load from the peak hours to the valley hours, and therefore greatly reduce the system peak load. Additionally, it is beneficial to improving the power system's reliability level.

articleTitle: Comprehensive economy and technology evaluation of photovoltaic energy storage system
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As energy shortages and pollution problems become more severe, as well as the increasing demand from users, conventional energy has shown a lot of shortcomings. The introduction of photovoltaic-energy storage system (PESS) can effectively take advantage of renewable photovoltaic power system, guarantee power quality and reduce environmental pollution. In this paper, the comprehensive economy and technology evaluation index system and evaluation method of PESS are studied. Firstly, the comprehensive evaluation index system of PESS was constructed from the aspects of economy, the reliability of power supply, the friendliness of the source and network, and the environmental benefits. Secondly, based on DEMATEL-ANP-Anti-Entropy and the improved grey correlation method, the weight of each assessment factor is determined; then the evaluation function of the index system of PESS can be formulated based on polynomial interpolation method; finally, the PESS which actually operates in a commercial park is comprehensively evaluated, the results of the study verify the feasibility and validity of the proposed index system and evaluation methods.

articleTitle: Three-stage voltage stability contingency screening and ranking
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Mid-long term voltage instability is an important category of voltage instability, but mid-long term analysis has difficulty dealing with large number of contingencies. To address this problem, a systemic approach of three-stage voltage stability contingency screening and ranking is proposed. Contingencies are screened through three stages of static, transient, and mid-long term analysis. Static and transient analysis methods are first used to shortlist a number of probably critical contingencies form a large list of credible contingencies; mid-long term analysis method is then used to identify contingencies that cause mid-long term voltage instability from the shortlist. Testing on a practical power system shows that the proposed approach can identify the contingencies causing mid-long term voltage instability, while mid-long term analysis deals with only a short list of contingencies. Under voltage instability causing contingencies, control strategies are made on critical nodes and are able to mitigate voltage instability.

articleTitle: Comprehensive severity evaluation of voltage sag based on entropy coefficient method considering subjectivity and objectivity
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A comprehensive severity evaluation index of voltage sag is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the grade classification of the evaluation index is identified according to the IEC 61000-2-8 table, and each duration interval is mapped to a normalized interval. Secondly, the influence degree of duration and magnitude are calculated respectively using subjective analytic hierarchy process (AHP) and objective weight function method. Then, by using entropy coefficient method with combination of AHP and weight function method, the influence degrees of duration and magnitude are obtained with consideration of subjectivity and objectivity. Finally, assuming that duration and magnitude are independent of each other, using the plural form and following the example of existing indices, several forms of voltage sag comprehensive influence degree index is proposed to evaluate voltage sag severity. Moreover, the evaluation results of the sag data coming from the power quality monitoring system of a city in China are obtained using the proposed method. By using entropy coefficient method, the results are more reasonable compared with one single method. Besides, the voltage sag severity of the sites can be described more accurately and truly through the comprehensive influence degree index based on the entropy weight method in actual power system.

articleTitle: Virtual power generator based hierarchical coordinated real-time dispatch strategy for wind farm clusters
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The main wind power utilization characteristics in China are large scale development and centralized integration. Wind power resource is mainly distributed in North, Northwest and Northeast of China, where the conventional units are dominated by coal-fired units with poor regulation flexibility. Operation experience shows that wind power curtailment happens frequently in most of these systems. This problem indicates that current dispatch method cannot effectively adapt to the power system operation with high wind power penetration. Comparing with conventional units, the poor dispatch ability of wind farm is mainly due to its uncertain and variable power output. In order to make better use of wind farm cluster's spatial smoothing effect and develop its dispatch flexibility, this paper proposes the new idea of wind farm cluster virtual power generator (WVPG) based hierarchical coordinated real-time dispatch strategy. For the dispatch center, WVPG participates in real-time dispatch in the form of a partly controllable quasi-regular power source. For the internal wind farms inside a WVPG, WVPG is responsible for the coordinated dispatch of individual wind farm's power output. A virtual power generator based hierarchical coordinated real-time dispatch strategy for wind farm clusters is proposed in this paper. The effectiveness of this strategy is verified by simulation cases referring to real wind power base system in Northwest China.

articleTitle: Impact analysis of UPFC on directional protection based on the power-frequency variation
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents quantitative analysis and simulation results of the influence of UPFC on directional protection based on the power-frequency variation. First, with a domestic 500 kV UPFC project as the basis, the principle and equivalent model of UPFC and its protection system are proposed. Next the principle of directional protection based on the power-frequency variation is introduced. Then quantitative analysis of the characteristics of power-frequency variation impedance calculated by the relay located at the UPFC side of line is carried out, which provides basis for quantitative estimation of the influence of UPFC on directional protection based on the power-frequency variation in the actual work. During forward faults, directional protection could operate reliably. During reverse faults, an expression is proposed on the relationship of power-frequency variation impedance, UPFC series injected voltage and the power-frequency variation relay voltage. When the amplitude of power-frequency variation relay voltage is less than UPFC series injected voltage amplitude, misoperation of the directional protection may occur. RTDS Simulation tests verify the validity of the theoretical analysis.

Author Keywords: directional protection based on the power-frequency variation

articleTitle: A quantitative economic assessment method for multi-national interconnections
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a quantitative economic assessment method for multi-national interconnections based on chronological production cost simulation model considering generation companies, load entities and transmission companies that participate in the interconnected system. A series of economic indices containing load payment, generation revenue, environmental impacts and investment cost about multinational interconnections are proposed in this paper. On the basis of these indices, a quantitative economic assessment model for energy sending end and receiving end is established respectively. And economic assessment of both sending end and receiving end of an interconnection project can be quantified by chronological production cost simulation. Case study is performed based on an assumption of interconnection between Sinkiang and the Gulf States. The interconnected system between Sinkiang and the Gulf States is established for the target planning year. Then production cost simulation is carried out to perform economic assessment for both sides under certain interconnection capacity. Study results indicate that the proposed approach provides a comprehensive economic and environmental analysis for all participators of multi-national interconnections.

articleTitle: Research on practicability of software defined network based communication network for smart grids
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The safe and stable operation of power grid is critical to the national economy and society, and communication network is essential to the power grid operation and even more essential to smart grids, which is the more dependent on the communication than the traditional grids. With the expansion of the scale of power grid and the unceasing enhancement of requirement of power supply reliability and power quality from customers, higher requirements on the performance of communication network for the electric power system is expected accordingly. As a new type of network architecture, software defined network has characteristics of forwarding and control separation, logical central control, programmable open interface. It can effectively improve the performance of the communication network for power systems and make it possible to fulfill the requirement of smart grids. This paper starts from the developing requirements on the communication network for smart grids, discusses the possibility and advantages of introducing software defined network technologies into communication network for smart grids. By analyzing the features and advantages of software defined network and the characteristics of communication services of smart grids, the applicability of it in the communication network for smart grids is illustrated.

articleTitle: Integration of load scheduling and direct load control for effective demand management
publicationTitle: 2017 China International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Requirement for network upgrade as a result of recent increase in peak demands has been a primary driver in the rise of electricity price in recent years. Additionally, the large deployment of variable renewable energy resources increases the risk of supply-demand mismatch, consequently, reducing the reliability of power system. These challenges will doubtless raise the need for a more sophisticated grid and demand response programs. The paper presents a detailed literature review of recent demand management strategies along with their limitations. The requirement for studying Load Scheduling and Direct Load Control in a single power network setup is highlighted. Additionally, the shortfalls of different tariff designs are discussed and the complexities in designing cost-reflective tariffs are presented. The paper concludes by bringing forward the attributes of an effective tariff design as well as proposing an economically viable system architecture for load scheduling as well as direct load control.
